rationale: Floor navigation already existed in v1.85.0. Reusing derived geometry and moving cache-miss computation off the UI thread improves that existing operation; it does not add a user-facing editor or document format.

summary.ru: Ускорено повторное открытие этажей; подготовка геометрии меньше мешает работе интерфейса.
summary.en: Reopening floors is faster, with geometry preparation causing less disruption to the interface.
